text:
sam_chen: Heads up — noticed billing attribution / quota counting mismatch when requests fail over from org key to project key. Dashboard shows duplicate token counts for same request path, looks like fallback pathing increments both org and project counters.

mira: oh interesting, do you have an example trace id?

sam_chen: trace: `trace-0b7e9` — saw `X-Auth-Path: org->fallback->project` in headers. Quota console shows +1 to org AND +1 to project for same trace.

jonr: that's bad. Our router should mark fallback as a transit and only charge final effective identity. Might be a metric emission bug in auth-proxy.

anya: quick check: are we calling both `meter.increment(org_counter)` and `meter.increment(project_counter)` in the same request lifecycle? We have some legacy code that increments on decode and again after resolution.

kevin_ops: infra-bot logged the request: `auth-proxy v3.4.1` applied `fallback-policy: project-prefer` at 12:04:12. Stack: auth-proxy -> quota-service -> billing-pusher.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: New canary deployed to staging cluster `us-west-2` 12:05 — image `auth-proxy:fix-quota-emit` (no rollout to prod). :rocket:

mira: If the quota-service accepts multiple attribution headers we need to decide canonicalization rules. Either canonicalize to `effective-identity` server-side or ensure upstream only emits once.

sam_chen: proposal: on the router we set header `X-Effective-Principal` once resolved, and change `quota-service` to only use `X-Effective-Principal` if present, ignoring intermediate `X-Origin-Principal`. That lets us preserve telemetry about fallbacks without double-charging.

jonr: agree. Also add a debug metric `quota.attempts.duplicated` when both headers present to catch older clients.

anya: small UX ask for console: show a new column in the quota table "attribution_path" that can be toggled to expand per-request path (org->fallback->project). Helps SREs triage.

kevin_ops: Implementation plan: 1) auth-proxy emits `X-Effective-Principal` after resolution, 2) quota-service prioritizes `X-Effective-Principal`, 3) backfill alert in console for sudden deltas, 4) canary rollout to dedicated clusters.

mira: rollout quirk — some older dedicated clusters still run `auth-proxy v3.2` which doesn't set `X-Effective-Principal`. We should make quota-service backwards-compatible: if no effective header, fall back to previous heuristic but emit `quota.attempts.duplicated` when both origin and resolved are seen.

sam_chen: test checklist for canary: 
```
- send request with org key that triggers fallback
- assert only project counter increments
- check `quota.attempts.duplicated == 0`
- ensure billing-pusher dedup logic unaffected
```

jonr: I'll open a quick PR to auth-proxy to set header and a follow-up PR to quota-service for prioritization + metric. Keep canary in staging for 48h and run synthetic load.

anya: console owners — can we add an alert rule: if ratio `sum(project_counters)/sum(total_counters)` changes >5% within 1h of deploy, open an automated incident? Otherwise noise will bury real regressions.

kevin_ops: good call. We'll add a temporary dashboard panel for the canary with both raw and canonicalized counts.

sam_chen: thanks all. tagging @mira for telemetry schema change and @kevin_ops for rollout. I'll paste the trace and sample logs in the ticket. :thumbsup:

mira: thanks — ping when PRs are up, will review ASAP.

infra-bot: ticket created: INFRA-2147 "Fallback routing quota double-count" — linked to canary deploy.
